details.description: Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS is Google's fast, cost-efficient text-to-speech model, released September 22, 2026 to replace the earlier gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview for high-throughput production and real-time voice agent applications, per the Gemini API changelog. It converts text into spoken audio across 101 languages with automatic language detection, supporting single- and multi-speaker generation, Voice design for custom vocal personas, and Voice replication with consent verification. As of 2026-09-24, Google's Gemini API models page lists it as a current 'New Stable' Flash-tier TTS model alongside the higher-fidelity Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS.
advantages: Google's Gemini API changelog describes it as a fast, cost-efficient TTS model built to replace gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview for high-throughput production and real-time voice agent cascades.
Supports 101 languages with automatic language detection, per Google's Gemini API speech-generation guide.
Supports Voice design, creating persistent custom vocal personas from text prompts, and Voice replication with consent verification, per Google's Gemini API changelog.
Ships with 30 prebuilt studio voices plus access to an Extended Voice Library of 150+ prebuilt and custom voices, per Google's Gemini API speech-generation guide and changelog.
Supports single- and multi-speaker generation (up to two speakers per request) with streaming audio output, per Google's Gemini API speech-generation guide.
Supports Batch API access for high-volume speech generation, per its Gemini API model page.
disadvantages: Accepts text input only, with no audio, image or video input, per its Gemini API model page.
Optimized for throughput and cost efficiency rather than the maximum acoustic fidelity of the flagship Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS model, per Google's Gemini API changelog.
Does not support the Live API for real-time conversation, function calling, code execution, or thinking, per its Gemini API model page.
use_cases: High-volume, high-throughput speech generation for production pipelines
Real-time voice agent cascades and conversational voice applications
Personalized audio through Voice replication with consent verification
General text-to-speech narration where studio-grade fidelity is not required

notes: Catalog facts (8,192 input / 16,384 output tokens, text input -> audio output, no deprecation date) match the Gemini API model page exactly. Released September 22, 2026 per the API changelog and deprecations page, explicitly as the replacement for gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview; no shutdown date is announced for this model. No accuracy-style benchmark score for this exact model was found on any Google page, so evaluations is left empty. The 101-language count is stated by Google but no full per-language list was found, so languages is left empty rather than guessed. Voice-count figures differ slightly across pages (30 prebuilt studio voices per the speech-generation guide vs. "150+ prebuilt and custom voices" in the Extended Voice Library per the changelog); both are reported as separate, attributed claims rather than reconciled into one number.
